entries.name: AgentDojo
entries.supported_claim: Prompt-injection and tool-use tasks for LLM agents.
entries.best_use: Study task construction and security/utility scoring.
entries.important_boundary: Translate its application environments into repository and developer-tool surfaces.

entries.name: garak
entries.supported_claim: Automated probes for multiple LLM failure classes.
entries.best_use: Generate a broad baseline scan against model endpoints.
entries.important_boundary: Add agent tools, repository fixtures, and action-level oracles.

entries.name: PyRIT
entries.supported_claim: Orchestrates prompts, targets, converters, scoring, and attack strategies.
entries.best_use: Build repeatable red-team campaigns and retain evidence.
entries.important_boundary: Define safe repository-specific targets and containment scoring.

entries.name: promptfoo red teaming
entries.supported_claim: Test matrices, assertions, and adversarial plugins for LLM applications.
entries.best_use: Run regression suites in CI across prompts and models.
entries.important_boundary: Instrument actual agent actions, file writes, and secret access.

entries.name: Giskard LLM scan
entries.supported_claim: Automated testing and scanning for LLM application risks.
entries.best_use: Find broad failure hypotheses and organize test cases.
entries.important_boundary: Model repository/tool permissions and deterministic canaries.

entries.name: Inspect Evals
entries.supported_claim: Reusable evaluation tasks for the Inspect AI framework.
entries.important_boundary: Create coding-agent injection fixtures; the catalog is broader than this use case.

entries.name: PurpleLlama CyberSecEval
entries.best_use: Borrow secure evaluation practices and selected risk tests.
entries.important_boundary: Map model-output tests to agent actions and repository content.

entries.name: OWASP prompt injection guidance
entries.supported_claim: Describes direct/indirect injection impacts and mitigation categories.
entries.best_use: Check that the fixture set covers remote content, encoding, persistence, and tool use.
entries.important_boundary: Turn narrative risks into inert executable cases.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
